K3 [Musk key-man]: Musk departure/incapacitation/major reputational event -> narrative premium collapses (fastest impairment path).
K4 [dilution]: $1T pay-package milestones vest triggering large share issuance -> per-share value diluted (watch O7 share-count basis).

K5 [AI-capex audit, NEW]: FCF stays negative >=2-3 quarters while capex does NOT convert into robotaxi/Optimus revenue -> the AI-capex thesis is disconfirmed for TSLA specifically -> tighter cap / existing EXIT candidate.
K6 [price un-cap]: base 5y IRR turns positive with delivered MOS (~<$160; deep MOS ~$110-130) -> only then does WATCH->STARTER enter discussion. Current $307.44 still ~2x buy_below.

The fat right tail (bull now +11%, moonshot +27%) is acknowledged and is why a holder HOLDs rather than dumps into the 52wk low -- but paying 285x with 1.4% margin and negative FCF for an unproven narrative, against a hostile rotation, is not a new-money buy.
